notes: Weak-field formula asserted only where M/p_semi <= 1e-3: of the 5 ref cases only (1000,2000) qualifies (p_semi=1333.3); the others are strong field and are NOT asserted against 6piM/p.

E.*_inward FAIL diagnosis: for massive plunges with L != 0, rdot ~ L/r near the cutoff (|V^2| ~ 2.6e5 at r=0.05, L=4), so the NM step h ~ eta r^(3/2) moves r by ~6% per step there; the residual (relative to E^2 = 1) is ~O(1). The optional rule r32+L (h <= r^2/|L|, r/|rdot|) cures that (see info.plungeResidualDiagnostic) but reaches ~1e-9 and then PLATEAUS (eta 2e-4, 1e-4, 5e-5 give ~1.5e-9, 1.2e-9, 1.7e-9: no eta^4 decrease), consistent with a round-off floor of the cancellation rdot^2 + V^2 (terms ~2.6e5) but not proven here; it does not reach 1e-10. No assert was loosened.

F: "distance b/tan(delta/2) past the apex" is implemented as the x-coordinate in the unrolled plane (wedge centred on +x). The radial distance along the cone surface to the seam point is b/sin(delta/2). Validation to confirm this reading.
